title: Do Dullahan / Skill Creator hooks see a played pawn's skill presses? (DPC 0.9.175-dev1)
intro: Follow-up to skill-mods-1. Dullahan's Rearmament option catches every skill press in the game's player input code and, if the skill doesn't match the ARISEN's weapon, swaps the Arisen's weapon and cancels the press. A played pawn uses that same input code. This test checks whether that bites. Same setup: outdoors, Arisen, co-op off, dummy ahead. About 4 minutes. End to start.

steps.text: 1/4 Arisen weapon SHEATHED. You play your SECOND pawn (other vocation than the Arisen). Use 2 skills on the dummy. Note if any doesn't fire. End.

expect.label: skill presses that went through the pawn's input processor
a skill ran (max skill id seen)

steps.text: 2/4 Back on the Arisen now: DRAW your weapon (stay in combat stance), then press End. Nothing else.
3/4 You play the SECOND pawn again (the Arisen keeps his weapon out). Use 2 skills. Note if any doesn't fire, and whether the ARISEN does anything (weapon swap). End.

expect.label: skill presses that went through the pawn's input processor
a skill ran (max skill id seen)

steps.text: 4/4 Done, back to the Arisen. Tell Claude what fired and what didn't in steps 1 and 3. End.

probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.state.active and ('playing '..tostring(D.state.pawn_name)) or 'Arisen') or ''
probes.pcs: if not _G.__dpc_pcs then _G.__dpc_pcs={n=0,last=-1}; local td=sdk.find_type_definition('app.PlayerInputProcessorDetail'); for _,m in ipairs(td:get_methods()) do if m:get_name()=='processCustomSkill' then local np=m:get_num_params(); pcall(sdk.hook,m,function(args) local s=_G.__dpc_pcs; local D=_G.DPC_dbg; if D and D.state.active then s.n=s.n+1; s.last=sdk.to_int64(args[np==8 and 3 or 4]) & 0xFFFFFFFF end end,function(r) return r end) end end end return _G.__dpc_pcs.n
probes.ar: local P=package.loaded['_NickCore/Properties']; if not P then return 'no NickCore' end; local ok,s=pcall(function() local t=P.human.Track; return 'job '..tostring(P.job)..' weapon '..tostring(P.weaponJob)..' track.All '..tostring(t.All)..' track.Skill '..tostring(t.Skill) end); return ok and s or 'err'
probes.rearm: local c=package.loaded['Dullahan/Config']; return c and tostring(c.REARMAMENT) or 'nil'
probes.skills: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local t={}; for s=1,4 do t[#t+1]=tostring(D.state.pawn_skills and D.state.pawn_skills[s] or '-') end; return table.concat(t,',')
probes.sk_now: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pc=D and D.state.pawn_chara; local ok,v=pcall(function() return pc:call('get_Human'):call('get_CustomSkillState') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
